data_output.description: data.py remains unchanged and returns encoded train/valid tuples (features, labels, user_ids) and test tuple (features, user_ids), where features is int32 shape (N,5) in canonical source row order and columns are [user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday].

model_input.description: Model receives an int32 feature matrix shaped (N,5) in canonical FIELDS order [user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday]. It returns a finite float score/logit vector shaped (N,). The score is additive bias plus all five parent ID terms plus one 32-unit ReLU residual computed exclusively from tab, hour, and weekday embeddings. Checkpoint state must include and restore all additive and residual parameters.
